provenance.note: first successful frozen run after transient ERDDAP retry; later transport fallback changes are not used to define this result

source.selection_gradient: PLOS S1 Data panel A, DOI 10.1371/journal.pbio.1002120.s001

spatial_proxy.description: fixed 3x3 coarse-grid bounding proxy for Ivory Coast

failed_conditions: pre-break slope is positive rather than negative
there is no declared pre-break decline from which a recovery fraction can be defined

history_test.reason: information reversal gate did not pass

observed_connectivity_notes: the rolling cue-driver correlation is highly nonstationary and changes sign multiple times
a sharp level change is visible near 2001 in the best unconstrained two-line fit, followed by increasing connectivity within the later segment
these patterns do not satisfy the preregistered decline-then-recovery definition and are not promoted to hysteresis
interpretation: the long-term lane does not support the preregistered cue-driver reversal required to open a path-dependence test
the negative gate result is retained without changing the cue window, breakpoint algorithm, driver or recovery criterion
Tomotani et al. 2021 remains prior art for cue-driver decoupling; PAYOFF-B novelty therefore remains asynchronous information uptake and topology-dependent memory rather than cue-decoupling itself
claim_boundary: do not relabel the 2001 segmented breakpoint as a confirmed climate-driven information collapse
do not use the known selection reversal around 2000/2001 to redefine the information breakpoint
do not open the registered history interaction after a failed reversal gate
this is a within-population cue-driver test, not an interaction-network hysteresis test
